def can_bob_win(n, ax, ay, bx, by, cx, cy):
    # Check if the target is in the same row or column as the king
    if bx == cx or by == cy:
        return "NO"
    
    # Check if the target is on the same diagonal as the king

        return "NO"
    
    # If none of the above conditions are met, Bob can win
